item.title: DeepSeek 排名第一的 V4 Flash 在真实智能体任务中表现欠佳，同时价格上涨
item.summary: DeepSeek's V4 Flash has topped model leaderboards and been hailed by developers as a "total monster" since its rollout. But in real-world testing, it completed just 53.8% of a batch of complex agent tasks.
